name: Secure the Mountain
objectiveText: Find Mountaineer Cornelius in the Grizzled Den for Mountaineer Gretchen .

comments.body: Cornelius is in the Grizzled Den Cave. Specifically the star shaped room to the right after you enter, he's lying in the middle of the frozen pond surrounded by wendigos.
replies: This is the same cave as https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=98326/frosthowl so you can save time by doing both. Frosthowl is at the end of the cave, where the path splits go left and down.
completes automatically if you walked near enough

comments.body: @ coordinates 43.0, 49.6 in the Grizzled Den Cave w/ the Wendigo's
